description: Fetch only one section of a report by keyword — much cheaper than get_report, best for RAG.

section.description: Heading keyword, matched as a substring against the report's OWN headings, so pass it in the report's language. A-share reports have Chinese headings (e.g. 第三节管理层讨论与分析) — use 管理层讨论与分析 / 财务报告 there. For English-language filings, "MD&A" / "financial statements" / "notes" work. If nothing matches, the API returns 404 with the real headings — retry with one of those, or call list_sections first.

name: get_section
